artifact: Riplox 1.5 desktop UI after the redesign migration @ b4790d8 (branch chapters)

gates.why: Insights is opened by a button that only exists in the library head
gates.tested_at: the library room, which is where a person can reach it

gates.why: same - Convert to audio is a library button since it stopped being a room
first run only opens when settings.first_run_done is false, which an install with a library never is
gates.tested_at: test_first_run.py, at the loader that decides it

gates.why: typing only happens into an overlay's field or a room's own search - a URL with no overlay is the URL bar, which is the app's oldest path and not what this migration changed

repros.name: danger-at-rest
repros.why: a ghost button that deletes was only red once the pointer was on it, which warns nobody

repros.name: danger-dialog-runtime
repros.why: the dialog's OK button is class=primary and only gains .danger at runtime - it looked like dead CSS and was nearly deleted

repros.name: failed-filter-hides-errors
repros.why: the filter named after failures was the one place a failed queue row did not appear

repros.name: library-collapse-source-order
repros.why: the two-column collapse rule sat before the rule it overrode, so at 700px the library still drew two columns

repros.name: duplicate-summary
repros.why: #pvSummary and .summary both already existed; adding a second of each gave a duplicate id and a shadowed rule

repros.name: insights-since-date
repros.why: 'since <date>' read as a start date when the library is capped at 300 and older records are dropped

repros.name: firstrun-on-upgrade
repros.why: first_run_done is missing from every old settings file, and missing must not read as false

repros.name: grab-counts-navigation
repros.why: counting every unreadable link put '48 sites Riplox has no reader for' under every page

repros.name: bad-as-gradient-end
repros.why: --bad is the failure colour and was used as the far end of three gradients: tab marker, backdrop, progress bar

repros.name: faux-bold
repros.why: <b> defaults to 700 and the app carries no 700 face, so uncaught <b> would be drawn as a synthesised bold

repros.name: unstyled-chip-em
repros.why: a quality chip's size sat in an <em> no rule claimed, so it rendered in the browser's default italic

sequences.name: palette-to-settings-row
steps: open the palette from a room that is not settings
the settings room opens, the row is scrolled to and marked

sequences.name: filter-then-reopen
steps: the chip and the list still agree

sequences.name: theme-flip-with-overlay-open
steps: the dialog repaints in the new theme

sequences.name: narrow-then-widen
steps: narrow to 1024 so the rail collapses
the rail's labels and the active marker come back
